paragraphs: New numbers from the Central Statistics Office look at how safe people feel. The office is called the CSO.
In the last year, 20% of women felt unsafe walking in their area. Only 11% of men felt the same.
The gap is biggest for young people. Among people aged 18 to 29, 65% of men felt very safe. But only 35% of women felt very safe.
Women in Dublin felt the least safe. Still, most people, 85%, said they feel safe in their area.
Some people also said crime changed their life. This was true for 18% of women and 14% of men.
sentZh: 中央統計局的新數據調查了人們感到多安全。
這個機構叫做CSO。
在過去一年，20%的女性在住家附近走路時感到不安全。
只有11%的男性有同樣感受。
年輕人之間的差距最大。
在18至29歲的人當中，65%的男性感到非常安全。
但只有35%的女性感到非常安全。
都柏林的女性感到最不安全。
不過，大多數人（85%）說他們在自己的地區感到安全。
也有人說犯罪改變了他們的生活。
18%的女性和14%的男性是這樣說的。

paragraphs: Women in Ireland are almost twice as likely as men to feel unsafe when they walk in their local area, according to figures from the Central Statistics Office (CSO).

The numbers, which The Journal obtained from the CSO, come from a study of crime and victims carried out between 2019 and 2025. They show that 20% of women felt unsafe walking in their area in the past year, compared with 11% of men. In every age group, women were less likely than men to say they felt very safe.
The biggest difference was among young adults. Of people aged 18 to 29, 65% of men said they felt very safe, but only 35% of women said the same.
There were also regional differences. Women felt least safe in Dublin, at 24%, and in the Mideast, at 23%. For men, Dublin also had the highest share who felt unsafe, at 15%.

Crime also affects daily life. About 18% of women and 14% of men said crime had affected their lives in the past year. However, most people, 85% in total, said they felt very or fairly safe walking near their homes.
sentZh: 根據中央統計局（CSO）的數據，愛爾蘭女性在住家附近走路時感到不安全的可能性幾乎是男性的兩倍。
The Journal從CSO取得的這些數字，來自2019年至2025年間進行的一項犯罪與受害者研究。
數據顯示，過去一年有20%的女性在住家附近走路時感到不安全，男性則為11%。
在每個年齡層中，女性說自己感到非常安全的比例都低於男性。
差異最大的是年輕成人。
在18至29歲的人中，65%的男性說他們感到非常安全，但只有35%的女性這麼說。
各地區之間也有差異。
女性在都柏林（24%）和中東部地區（23%）感到最不安全。
對男性而言，都柏林感到不安全的比例也是最高的，為15%。
犯罪也影響日常生活。
約18%的女性和14%的男性說，過去一年犯罪影響了他們的生活。
不過，大多數人（共85%）說他們在住家附近走路時感到非常或相當安全。

paragraphs: Women in Ireland are almost twice as likely as men to feel unsafe walking in their local area, according to Central Statistics Office (CSO) figures obtained by The Journal.

The data, drawn from the CSO's crime and victimisation study covering 2019 to 2025, shows that 20% of women felt unsafe walking in their neighbourhood over the previous 12 months, compared with 11% of men. Across all adult age groups, women were less likely than men to describe themselves as feeling very safe.
The gender gap was widest among 18 to 29-year-olds: 65% of young men reported feeling very safe, against just 35% of young women.
